summary: Analyzed live specifications against the accepted control-room-serve proposal and produced spec-lens-c.md. Documented the inventory, zero conflict status, and verbatim live blocks for modified requirements in approvals-web-ui.

hard_stops.hard_stop: A capability the proposal lists as modified has no live spec to read.
A requirement being removed has consumers the proposal never mentions, so removing it breaks behavior nobody agreed to break.
Copying a MODIFIED block whole would exceed what you can write, so the copy would have to be partial. Report which requirement forces it; never write a partial block.
Satisfying one instruction in this packet would require violating another.

files_changed.why: Spec Lens C feedstock containing assumed requirements, live spec inventory, conflict analysis, and verbatim modified requirement blocks.

done_criteria.criterion: Every capability listed as modified was opened in full, and its inventory row's requirement and scenario counts came from the file rather than an estimate.
done_criteria.evidence: openspec/specs/approvals-web-ui/spec.md:1-83 was read in full, confirming exactly 4 requirements and 9 scenarios.

done_criteria.criterion: Every ## MODIFIED Full Blocks entry is the complete live block, scenario for scenario, with nothing summarized or elided.
done_criteria.evidence: openspec/changes/control-room-serve/spec-lens-c.md:21-61 contains verbatim copies of Requirement: Loopback Binding (2 scenarios) and Requirement: Individual Decisions Without Bulk Approval (3 scenarios) matching openspec/specs/approvals-web-ui/spec.md:10-48.

done_criteria.criterion: Every removal or rename names its consumers with file:line and carries a Reason.
done_criteria.evidence: openspec/changes/control-room-serve/spec-lens-c.md:63-68 records that no requirements are removed or renamed by this change.

done_criteria.criterion: spec-lens-c.md exists, is under 1000 words excluding the verbatim blocks, and carries ## Assumed requirements and ## Live Spec Inventory.
done_criteria.evidence: openspec/changes/control-room-serve/spec-lens-c.md contains ## Assumed requirements and ## Live Spec Inventory; authored text is ~285 words (well below the 1000-word limit).

done_criteria.criterion: The work is committed with a conventional commit and no AI attribution (git status --porcelain empty and git log --oneline -1).
done_criteria.evidence: git log --oneline -1 output: '72145d3 docs(spec): add spec lens c for control-room-serve'; git status --porcelain is empty.
